name: dev_changing_capacity_scaleup
description: Changing-capacity scale-up: cluster starts at 4 CPU and scales to 8 CPU at t=10s. scale-big (6 CPU, 18s) is infeasible on the initial 4 CPU cluster; scale-small (4 CPU, 4s) fits on the initial 4 CPU cluster. Under FIFO scale-big blocks the queue head (HOL blocking); after the scale-up event scale-big is admitted (using 6 of 8 CPU), leaving only 2 CPU free — scale-small needs 4 CPU so it cannot be admitted until scale-big finishes at t=28, then runs from t=28 to t=32 (exceeds the 30s horizon). Under greedy scale-small runs first (t=0 to t=4) before the scale-up, then scale-big runs from t=10 to t=28 — both complete within the horizon.
